zh: 切口从左往右移动时，每次只有一个字符从右边部分移到左边部分，两边的不同字符数只会因为这个字符发生变化。
先统计整个串每个字母的出现次数作为右侧频次。依次把字符移入左侧：左侧用集合或布尔数组记录出现过的字母，右侧频次减一，频次变成 0 时右侧不同字符数减一。
共有 n−1 个切口（左右都非空），在每个字符移入左侧之后（最后一个字符除外）比较两边的不同字符数，相等就计数加一。整个过程是 O(n)，字母表只有 26 个。
en: As the cut moves right, exactly one character moves from the right part to the left part, so each side's distinct count can only change because of that character.

Start with the letter counts of the whole string as the right side. Move characters to the left one by one: mark the letter as seen on the left, decrement its right count, and when that count reaches 0 the right side loses one distinct letter.

There are n−1 cuts with both parts non-empty. After moving each character except the last, compare the two distinct counts and count the cut when they are equal. This is O(n) with a 26-letter alphabet.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Start with the right-side frequencies of the whole string and move characters into the left side one by one, maintaining the number of distinct characters on both sides.

## Correctness

Every valid cut is checked exactly once, right after the last character on its left is moved over. A distinct count is updated whenever a frequency goes from positive to zero or from zero to positive, so the compared values are always correct.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(26) space.
